correctness.rationale: On the zero-sum subspace the rank-one formula follows exactly from the cycle Green kernel and Sherman–Morrison with nonzero denominator. Median duality yields the sharp compatible-forcing norm. The quadratic cycle Green values have two median crossings at quarter distance. A uniformly bounded edge-rank perturbation modifies only boundedly many signs near each crossing, giving a uniform O_w(1) remainder. Riemann sums produce the explicit piecewise quadratic profile with maximum 1/16 at 1/4 and 3/4 and zeros at 0, 1/2, 1. Exact arithmetic verifies the homogeneous residue formula; a separately implemented rational-matrix solver and direct extremizers passed 4269 assertions. Fixed-w and real-forcing restrictions are explicit.

value.rationale: A single variable-conductance edge is a standard model for network bottleneck robustness. The new coefficient measures sharp bounded-compatible-load amplification at subleading order n, with a directional asymmetry between weakening and strengthening and a non-obvious relocation of worst response to quarter positions. These quantities cannot be read off from resistance or spectral-gap estimates alone. The exact homogeneous norm and finite median formula make the limit reproducible, rather than just an abstract perturbation bound.
